# Irha Apparels — Expanded Public Website Summary

## Company positioning

Irha Apparels is an experienced B2B custom apparel manufacturer based in Sialkot, Pakistan. The company serves brands, wholesalers, importers, retailers, clubs and private-label buyers through OEM, ODM and made-to-requirement apparel programs.

The website is for business inquiries rather than consumer retail. Fixed prices are not published. Commercial details are confirmed after the buyer shares product type, quantity, materials, construction, branding, packaging, destination and target schedule.

Irha Apparels does not claim factories or offices in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, the United States, Canada, Australia or New Zealand. Manufacturing takes place in Sialkot, Pakistan. Qualified buyers may request a live factory video call.

## Two production hubs

The public website groups the manufacturing offer into two production hubs so buyers can navigate the range without implying that separate factories or legal entities exist.

1. Bavarian & Leather
   - Bavarian and Trachten wear
   - Lederhosen and Dirndl programs
   - Premium leather apparel

2. Sportswear, Streetwear & Leisure
   - Teamwear and club kits
   - Performance sportswear and activewear
   - Heavyweight streetwear
   - Leisurewear and nightwear

## Manufacturing categories

### Bavarian and Trachten wear

- Lederhosen in short, knee-length and long formats
- Dirndl dresses, blouses and aprons
- Trachten shirts, vests, jackets and Janker programs
- Suspenders, belts, hats, socks and related accessories

### Premium leather apparel

- Biker and motorcycle-inspired jackets
- Bomber and fashion leather jackets
- Leather vests and waistcoats
- Custom lining, hardware, labels, patches and packaging

### Sportswear

- Football, rugby, basketball, cricket and hockey uniforms
- Tracksuits, warm-up sets and training wear
- Club, school and distributor programs
- Team artwork, names, numbers and repeat-order references where agreed

### Streetwear and activewear

- T-shirts, including heavyweight programs
- Hoodies, sweatshirts and fleece sets
- Tracksuits, activewear and branded basics
- Embroidery, screen print, DTF and other decoration subject to product review

### Leisurewear and nightwear

- Buyer-specified leisure and sleepwear programs
- Fabrics, trims, labels and packaging confirmed per inquiry

## Private-label capabilities

Publicly described capabilities include custom cut and sew, embroidery, printing, sublimation where appropriate, woven labels, care labels, size labels, hang tags, buyer-specified packaging and export support. Exact capability and suitability depend on the product brief and are confirmed during requirement review.

A private-label order may include:

1. Product and material review
2. Sample or pre-production approval
3. Measurement, construction and decoration checkpoints
4. Buyer-approved labels and packaging
5. Written production, shipping and commercial terms

## Commercial accuracy policy

The public website does not treat sample copy, concept images or automated calculations as binding quotations. Materials, MOQ, pricing, production timing, shipping method, documentation and compliance evidence are confirmed for each buyer requirement.

Do not infer that every product uses the same MOQ, production time, material or certification. Do not infer certification status from educational content. Evidence is provided before a claim is made to a buyer.

## Buyer trust

Buyer verification should focus on the relevant team, program scope, written quotation and program-specific evidence. An appointment-based live factory call may be requested as a verification step, subject to availability and viewing scope.

## Contact context

Official contact details should be taken from the current Contact page. The website supports business inquiries by email, WhatsApp and inquiry forms. Buyers should provide product type, quantity, materials, artwork, labels, packaging, destination and desired delivery window for an initial feasibility review.
